enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow under head. Pull blanket up to chin. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Turn to back. Place arm under pillow. Turn to left side. Pull blanket over shoulder. Remain still. Breathe slowly.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, showering, brushing teeth and washing face
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Get out of bed. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water heater. Undress and step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap and rub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel and dry body. Wrap towel around waist. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth and rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face. Turn off water heater and light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Boiling the kettle, preparing and eating breakfast
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Fill kettle with water and turn it on. Open refrigerator and take out milk, eggs, and bread. Close refrigerator. Place frying pan on stove and turn on stove. Crack eggs into pan and stir. Toast bread in toaster and butter it. Pour milk into glass. Pour boiling water into cup and add tea bag. Stir tea. Sit at table. Eat eggs and toast. Drink tea and milk. Finish meal. Pick up plate and cup and walk to sink. Rinse and place in dishwasher. Wipe table. Turn off stove and kettle.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and checking phone for community program messages and news
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt and pants. Close wardrobe. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Pick up phone from nightstand. Press power button to wake screen. Swipe to unlock. Open messaging app. Read community program messages. Reply to messages. Open news app. Scroll through headlines. Close news app. Place phone on desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Setting up the home workspace at the desk, reviewing the calendar and program to-do list
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open laptop. Press power button to turn on computer. Adjust chair height. Log in to computer. Open calendar app. Review today's schedule. Open program to-do list. Read tasks. Check off completed tasks. Add new tasks. Close calendar. Open email client. Check unread emails. Reply to urgent emails. Close email. Place phone on desk. Adjust desk lamp angle.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on the computer: answering emails, drafting grant reports and joining video calls
enriched_activities.desc: Open email client. Read new emails. Type replies to emails. Send replies. Open grant report document. Type report content. Format text. Save document. Open video call application. Join video meeting. Speak during meeting. Listen to colleagues. Take notes on paper. Leave video meeting. Open volunteer coordination spreadsheet. Update volunteer schedules. Send emails to volunteers. Open program documentation. Edit documentation. Save changes. Close all applications.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator and take out bread, cheese, and vegetables. Close refrigerator. Slice bread and place cheese and vegetables on it. Put sandwich on plate. Open microwave and place plate inside. Close microwave and press start. Wait for microwave. Open microwave and take out plate. Sit at table. Eat sandwich and drink water. Finish meal. Pick up plate and walk to sink. Rinse plate and place in dishwasher. Wipe table.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a short break, stretching and resting
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Stretch arms overhead. Stretch legs forward. Lean back. Close eyes. Breathe deeply. Open eyes. Stand up. Walk back to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing work on the computer: coordinating volunteers, updating program schedules and documentation
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Wake computer. Open volunteer coordination database. Update volunteer contact information. Send email to volunteers. Open program schedule spreadsheet. Update schedule. Save spreadsheet. Open documentation file. Edit documentation. Save documentation. Open video call for team meeting. Join meeting. Discuss volunteer coordination. Take notes. Leave meeting. Open email. Reply to volunteer inquiries. Close applications. Turn off desk lamp.

Walk to living room. Pick up TV remote. Press power button to turn on TV. Sit on couch. Press channel button to change channel. Watch TV program. Adjust volume. Lean back. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Browse social media. Look up at TV. Put down phone. Watch TV. Press power button to turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner, then cleaning up
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator and take out chicken, vegetables, and rice. Close refrigerator. Wash and chop vegetables. Place chicken in pan and turn on stove. Cook chicken and add vegetables. Stir and add rice. Cook until done. Turn off stove. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner and drink water. Finish meal. Pick up plate and walk to sink. Rinse plate and place in dishwasher. Wipe table. Turn off kitchen light.

enriched_activities.activity: Leisure time watching TV and browsing on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up TV remote. Turn on TV. Browse channels. Watch TV show. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open social media app. Scroll through feed. Watch video on phone. Put down phone. Watch TV. Pick up phone again. Check messages. Reply to message. Put down phone. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to bathroom.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water heater. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face. Turn off water heater. Turn off bathroom light. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and winding down on the phone before sleep
enriched_activities.desc: Lie on bed. Pick up book from nightstand. Open book. Read pages. Put down book. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open reading app. Read article. Scroll down. Close app. Open social media. Browse feed. Put down phone. Turn off desk lamp. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes.
Lie in bed. Pull blanket over shoulder. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Breathe slowly. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Turn to back. Remain still. Sleep.
